description: This source file defines API endpoints for managing reminders within a customer management and billing system. It includes functions to list reminders, send new reminders via email or WhatsApp, and retrieve details of specific reminders. The file interacts with database models to fetch and store reminder data, and utilizes external integrations for message delivery.
